integrity: Includes a fully specified proof, standalone reproducible checker, exact source references, and explicit bounds on verification. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled simple cycles of length at least 3, counted as ordered partitions. The local forbidden-word equivalence requires length at least 5; lengths 3 and 4 are explicitly corrected. Bibliographic priority beyond inspected sources is not certified. Computational enumerations are finite checks, while the all-length theorem has a written combinatorial proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact enumeration of dominating–locating-dominating partitions of cycles
